title: BMS picks Texas for new $2.3B manufacturing campus
snippet: Bristol Myers Squibb’s $2.3 billion Houston manufacturing campus is part of the company’s larger $40 billion investment designed to bolster American innovation and manufacturing.

title: Sionna’s cystic fibrosis failure is a windfall for Vertex’s blockbuster franchise
snippet: A surprise flop in Phase 2a cystic fibrosis trial sent Sionna’s shares plummeting, but for Vertex, the news reinforced its standard-of-care standing with highly successful drugs like Trikafta.

title: Jazz commits up to $1.3B to buy Actio, bolster epilepsy pipeline
snippet: Jazz Pharmaceuticals is reaching into its wallet once again, this time buying Actio Biosciences and an experimental therapy for KCNT1+ epilepsy, a form of the disease with no FDA-approved treatments.

title: All eyes on psychedelic drugmakers as Definium, Compass near major catalysts
snippet: Definium Therapeutics’ closely watched anxiety readout could further validate its single-dose LSD candidate, while Compass Pathways advances a psilocybin program through a rolling FDA filing.
